resources.string: Lets Chinu control your phone by voice: screenshots, lock, home, back, scrolling, notifications and auto-sending WhatsApp messages. Chinu never stores or shares what is on your screen.

💞 Hugs, kisses, love notes, Touch Together & Love Wheel between Chiku and Komal
👠 Komal's Closet: new heels & tops every day, unlocked by winning a game
🐦 Say "Hi Chinu" anytime — a small card with the green bird pops up on any screen 🗣️ Every answer is spoken out loud and shown on screen 🧠 Ask anything ("Narendra Modi kaun hai?") in any language 📞 Calls by name — emojis in contact names are ignored 💬 WhatsApp messages, sent automatically 📸 Screenshot of any app ("WhatsApp ka screenshot lo") 🔒 Lock · Home · Back · Notifications · Scroll · Split screen 🎵 Plays any song by itself — YT Music, Spotify, YouTube or any app
⏰ Alarms · Timers · Torch · Volume · Music controls ⚙️ Turns settings ON/OFF: WiFi · Bluetooth · Hotspot · Data · Location · DND · Airplane · Auto-rotate · Dark mode 🔋 Battery · Date · Time · Calculator · Navigation · Camera 🎂 Birthday countdown and midnight wishes 🌐 12 languages
